Anchor Soma Dewangan Arrested Over Video Criticizing Mayor

Anchor and YouTuber Soma Dewangan was arrested in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, following a complaint about an "objectionable" video she posted criticizing the mayor. Congress workers staged a protest following her arrest. The specific details of the video and the exact charges against Dewangan were not detailed in the provided coverage.
